issues.quote: The limitations in Section 9.2 apply to all claims, including claims under Section 8 and breaches of Section 4.
issues.deviation: The cap swallows indemnity and confidentiality claims.
issues.recommendation: Carve indemnity and confidentiality breaches out of the cap.
issues.fallback: Data-protection breaches under a super-cap of 3x the general cap.

issues.quote: hold harmless Provider from any claim arising out of any breach of this Agreement
issues.deviation: One-way customer indemnity for any breach.
issues.recommendation: Replace with a provider IP indemnity; narrow the customer indemnity.
issues.fallback: Mutual third-party-claim indemnities limited to IP infringement.

issues.quote: shall not exceed the fees paid by Customer in the three (3) months preceding the claim
issues.deviation: Cap is three months of fees; the playbook wants twelve.
issues.recommendation: Raise the cap to twelve months of fees paid or payable.
issues.fallback: Six months with a USD 250,000 floor.

issues.quote: any Customer Data for any purpose, including to train
issues.deviation: Perpetual licence to train on Customer Data.
issues.recommendation: Limit the licence to feedback used to improve the Services.
issues.fallback: Aggregated, de-identified usage data only, never for training.

issues.quote: notify Customer of a security incident affecting Customer Data within a commercially reasonable time
issues.deviation: No fixed breach-notice window and no DPA.
issues.recommendation: Notice within 72 hours and a DPA as an exhibit.

issues.quote: the fees paid by Customer in the three (3) months
issues.deviation: Cap base counts fees paid only.
issues.fallback: Fees paid in the 12 months before the claim.

issues.fallback: A 90-day warranty with re-performance as the remedy.
